method: server started fresh; /stats; jcmd GC.run then GC.heap_info for heap; ps RSS; then 200 queries (main 50 + 150 check queries) x 3 rounds x {smart, keyword}; tookMs = server-side time incl. snippets

int8.smartRanking: hybrid RRF k=60: keyword top 100 [BM25(body) + w*BM25(title) k1=1.2 w=2 b_title=0.75 b_body=0.3 | x (1 + 0.5 x PageRank) | AND, else OR | question words dropped] + HNSW M=16 efC=200 efSearch=200 (int8 vectors), top 100
